item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00422","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C23","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.88,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 plausibly supplied a material template for the child: both are presidential letters responding appreciatively to a report produced by multiple officials, praising concrete progress benefiting small business, emphasizing small business as vital to the national economy, directing or promising further executive-branch action, and requesting continued work or progress information. C23 is a strong substantive precursor because it documents the recommendation, planning, and purpose of the exact conference discussed in the child, but it is less similar as a response-letter drafting model. C17 parallels the assistance and periodic-progress-report machinery but concerns an unrelated program.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Thank you very much for the report that you and Mr. Barnes sent me about the Conference on Technical and Distribution Research for the Benefit of Small Business.","parent_excerpt":"I was particularly pleased to receive and read the Progress Report of the Cabinet Committee on Small Business which you and your colleagues have been working on for many weeks.","explanation":"Both open by warmly acknowledging a report prepared by the addressee with other officials concerning a federal small-business initiative."},{"child_excerpt":"the Conference was successful both in making better known the many facilities for strengthening the position of small businesses and also in developing a specific program for further accomplishment","parent_excerpt":"The scope of the Report's analysis and recommendations demonstrates that no constructive potential avenue of improvement—either legislative or executive—is being overlooked in our search to widen the opportunities for small businesses in America.","explanation":"Both praise the reported initiative for identifying concrete means and further programs to improve the position of small businesses."},{"child_excerpt":"further enlarge the vital role of small business in our way of life","parent_excerpt":"strengthen this vital segment of the American economy","explanation":"The letters use closely parallel language characterizing small business as a vital national institution."},{"child_excerpt":"I shall expect the Department of Commerce and the Small Business Administration to render all possible assistance ... I shall look forward to hearing from you from time to time on the progress that is made.","parent_excerpt":"I shall ask the departments principally concerned to advise me further. ... I urge the Committee to continue its studies of small business problems and to keep its findings current","explanation":"Each concludes with presidential direction for continued executive work and subsequent advice or reporting."}]}
